title: Family life
subtitle: Household chores, family values & sharing responsibilities

lessons.title: Getting started – Household chores
objectives: Gain an overview of the topic 'Family life';
Understand and use vocabulary to talk about household chores;
Identify the present simple and present continuous tenses in context.
Core Competences:
Develop communication skills and creativity;
Be collaborative and supportive in pair work and teamwork;
Actively join in class activities.
Personal Qualities:
Be aware of personal responsibilities towards family life;
Cultivate self-study habits.
Digital & AI Competences:
3: Use AI tools to generate ideas or search for vocabulary and images related to family life and domestic duties.
2: Maintain human oversight and critical control when evaluating AI-generated family roles and chore descriptions.

lessons.title: Language – Pronunciation /tr/, /br/, /kr/ & Present simple vs. Present continuous
lessons.short_title: Pronunciation /tr/, /br/, /kr/ & Present simple vs. Present continuous
objectives: Pronounce the consonant blends /br/, /kr/, and /tr/ correctly in isolated words and in connected sentences;
Understand and use lexical items related to family roles and household duties;
Distinguish and correctly use the Present Simple and Present Continuous tenses.
Core Competences:
Develop phonetic discrimination, grammatical precision, and communicative fluency;
Work collaboratively in pairs and groups.
Personal Qualities:
Appreciate the value of sharing housework and supporting family members;
Foster independent study habits.
Digital & AI Competences:
3: Use AI tools, digital dictionaries, and pronunciation applications to look up word definitions and phonetic blends.
2: Practice structuring simple prompts to query grammar rules and verify tense usage examples.

lessons.title: Reading – Benefits of doing housework
objectives: Develop reading comprehension skills for specific information in a text about the benefits of doing housework for children;
Understand and use lexical items related to character development, gratitude, and family bonds.
Core Competences:
Develop scanning, skimming, contextual vocabulary deduction, and mind-mapping skills;
Work collaboratively in pairs and groups.
Personal Qualities:

Digital & AI Competences:
3: Use AI tools to search for and synthesize additional research on the developmental benefits of chores for teenagers.
2: Evaluate AI-generated summaries against textbook facts to ensure information reliability.

lessons.title: Speaking – Why should/shouldn't children do housework?
objectives: Explain why children should or shouldn't do housework;
Express opinions, agreement, and disagreement in structured conversations about family chores.
Core Competences:
Develop oral argumentation, role-play dialogue, and critical thinking skills;
Collaborate in pairs and groups.
Personal Qualities:
Form balanced viewpoints on balancing study, play, and family responsibilities.
Digital & AI Competences:
2: Practice using AI conversational prompts to simulate dialogue partner responses.
1: Analyze the social implications of chore division between genders and age groups.

Doing housework helps them develop life skills, 2. They should be given plenty of playtime

lessons.title: Writing – Writing about family routines & chores
objectives: Knowledge:\n
Understand the structure and language of an email describing family routines;\n
Write a structured 120–150 word body paragraph of an email describing family routines using transition linkers (First, Second, Third, Finally).\n
Core Competences:\n
Develop paragraph organization, idea sequencing, and peer-review skills;\n
Work collaboratively.\n
Personal Qualities:\n
Value meaningful family traditions and maintain academic integrity.\n
Digital & AI Competences:\n
3: Use AI writing assistants to explore transitional phrases and paragraph coherence models.\n
1: Maintain authentic personal family voice, avoid over-reliance on AI, and complete the Student AI Declaration Form.

Respect cultural diversity and embrace positive Vietnamese and British family values.\n

3: Use digital tools to search for and verify traditional British family traditions.\n
